signals.sine1k: 1 kHz mono sine wave with 20 ms edge fades
signals.sweep: Mono logarithmic sweep from 20 Hz to min(20 kHz, 0.45 x sample rate) with 20 ms edge fades
signals.pink: Deterministic seeded pink-noise approximation normalized to the selected peak ceiling
signals.channels: Stereo 440 Hz sequence: both, left, right, both
signals.phase: Stereo 440 Hz sequence: first half in phase, second half with right-channel polarity inverted

levelMeaning: The selected dBFS value is a digital peak ceiling, not a calibrated SPL, LUFS or RMS reference.
safety: No signal auto-plays. Start with monitor volume low. High-frequency or continuous test signals can be uncomfortable. These files are not hearing tests or medical diagnostic material.
privacy: Generation is performed in the browser. The generator does not intentionally upload generated audio or measurement notes.
